bias-follow.lede1: Bias is chart-aligned to each D1 bar’s open→close outcome — not EMA, not MACD, and not joinDir. Engines still produce BUY/SELL; an armed bias lane filters which sides may enter via FollowDir.
bias-follow.riskDoNotBody: GSignalX opens · ProfitScouter closes · STOP ≠ FLAT. Bias never closes tickets. While a lane is armed, entries stay one-sided to that lane’s live direction.
bias-follow.td2: Floating: live mid vs today’s D1 open (forming candle)
bias-follow.td5: Static: last closed D1 close vs that bar’s open
bias-follow.td11: Clear armed lane — default any-dir follow
bias-follow.li1: Trade Center — click Daily / Pre-D / Third-D / Signal. Desk-wide: each roster pair gets FollowDir from that pair’s bias for the chosen lane.
bias-follow.li2: Chart panel — same chips apply to this symbol only.
bias-follow.li3: Row bias cells arm the lane (not “copy this row’s value onto everyone”).
bias-follow.li4: Manual Mode / FDIR pads clear the armed bias lane.
bias-follow.liveBody: Effective FollowDir tracks the armed lane’s live direction. NEUT blocks new entries (WAIT). Signal returns to AUTO. Bias never closes positions — Scouter still banks winners. Plan: docs/plans/DAILY_BIAS_FOLLOW_PLAN.md.
bias-follow.lede2: Structure first, then size, then harvest. Bias is a filter — not an exit.
bias-follow.ol1: Topology A — Trade Center DeskExecute ON, FIXED practice lot, Scouter CASH ON.
bias-follow.ol2: Read the columns — Daily / Pre / Third. Prefer Daily when the session is open.
bias-follow.ol3: Arm once — click desk Daily to filter the fleet. Use Signal when you want any side again.
bias-follow.ol4: NEUT — if Daily is doji (WAIT), wait for structure or clear to Signal; do not force size.
bias-follow.ol5: Bank with Scouter — never use a bias click as an exit. STOP blocks entries; it does not flatten.
bias-follow.do1: Arm Daily when overall BULL/BEAR and liquidity is open
bias-follow.dont1: Expect bias to close losers or winners
bias-follow.do2: Use Signal to return to default any-dir follow
bias-follow.dont2: Fight Daily BEAR with forced BUY FollowDir
bias-follow.dont3: Treat NEUT as “both sides allowed” — it is WAIT
